top_story.title: Stock Market Today: Dow Jumps 500 Points, Sets Aside Hot Inflation; NetApp Offers Second Chance (Live Coverage)
top_story.summary: Friday's inflation report raised the odds of an interest rate hike at next week's Federal Reserve meeting, but investors drove the stock market higher as they weighed a lower risk of larger rate hikes further down the tightening cycle.  Meanwhile, NetApp made a second breakout attempt and offered an entry.  The Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 1%, or more than 500 points, as the S&P 500 also moved up 1%.
